items.html: *Now it has been explained above, in the previous discourses, that there is a Partzuf of upper Bina of Ehyeh of Yudin, and a Partzuf of Tvuna of SAG; and we shall now speak of the Partzuf of Tvuna of SAG alone, which has within it KHB and three Tvunas, as above. And it has already been explained above that the externality of the upper one becomes internality in the lower one, and all this is in the phase of vessels.
